war-remnants.name: War Remnants Museum
war-remnants.price_text: ≈ VND 40,000 adult · check on the day
war-remnants.hours: Daily roughly 07:30–17:30 · last entry about 30 min before close
war-remnants.tip: Go early to avoid the heat and crowds. The upper floors on Agent Orange are heavy; allow time to sit afterwards.

cu-chi.name: Cu Chi Tunnels
cu-chi.price_text: ≈ VND 35,000 entry · tours cost more; check on the day
cu-chi.tip: About 1.5–2 hours by road each way. Book a half-day tour with pickup and bring water and a hat.

notre-dame.name: Notre Dame Cathedral of Saigon
notre-dame.hours: Exterior visible any time · interior often closed for restoration, check on the day
notre-dame.tip: The red-brick facade is best in soft morning light. Pair it with the Post Office across the square.

independence-palace.name: Independence Palace
independence-palace.price_text: ≈ VND 65,000 adult · check on the day
independence-palace.tip: Climb to the rooftop helipad and the war rooms below. Audio guides help make sense of the 1975 tank story.

central-post-office.name: Saigon Central Post Office
central-post-office.tip: Still a working post office. Send yourself a postcard from the old wooden counters.

ben-thanh.name: Ben Thanh Market
ben-thanh.price_text: Free to enter · food and goods priced per stall
ben-thanh.hours: Daily roughly 06:00–18:00 · night food stalls later
ben-thanh.tip: Agree prices before buying and expect to bargain. The food stalls inside are good for a quick local lunch.
ben-thanh.best: Morning for shopping, evening for the night stalls

bach-dang.name: Bach Dang Wharf
bach-dang.price_text: Free to walk · boat rides cost extra
bach-dang.hours: Open any time · boat services daytime to evening
bach-dang.tip: Good spot for a river breeze and skyline photos. Watch the traffic before crossing the road.

bitexco.name: Bitexco Financial Tower
bitexco.price_text: ≈ VND 200,000 skydeck · check on the day
bitexco.tip: The open-air helipad deck gives the best view over the river. Go near sunset for cooler air and lights.

jade-emperor.name: Jade Emperor Pagoda
jade-emperor.tip: It is an active temple, so dress modestly and keep quiet. The smoky incense halls are very photogenic.

landmark-81.name: Landmark 81
landmark-81.price_text: ≈ VND 250,000 skyview · check on the day
landmark-81.tip: Vietnam's tallest building. The observation deck is best after dark when the city lights up.

saigon-river.name: Saigon River
saigon-river.price_text: Free to walk the banks · cruises cost extra
saigon-river.tip: Walk the riverside promenade in District 1 at dusk. Sunset boat cruises leave from nearby piers.

suoi-tien.name: Suối Tiên Amusement Park
suoi-tien.price_text: ≈ VND 150,000 entry · rides extra; check on the day
suoi-tien.tip: A quirky themed water and culture park well outside the centre. Bring swimwear and plan a half day.

tan-dinh.name: Tan Dinh Church
tan-dinh.hours: Exterior any time · interior at mass times, check on the day
tan-dinh.tip: The pink facade is the draw. Visit early for soft light and fewer people in photos.

dai-nam.name: Đại Nam Văn Hiến
dai-nam.price_text: ≈ VND 200,000 entry · check on the day
dai-nam.tip: A large temple-and-theme-park complex far from the city. It needs most of a day, so go with a car or tour.

dam-sen.name: Đầm Sen Park
dam-sen.price_text: ≈ VND 120,000 entry · water park extra; check on the day
dam-sen.tip: Good for families with kids. Bring a change of clothes for the water park.

ben-thanh-night.name: Ben Thanh night food stalls
ben-thanh-night.tip: The streets around the market fill with grills and seafood at night. Point at what looks busy and fresh.

pham-ngu-lao.name: Pham Ngu Lao backpacker street
pham-ngu-lao.price_text: Free to walk · drinks and food extra
pham-ngu-lao.hours: Busy from evening into late night
pham-ngu-lao.tip: The classic budget-traveller strip. Good for cheap eats, bars and booking onward buses.

street-food-tour.name: Evening street food tour by scooter
street-food-tour.tip: A fun way to try many dishes and cross the city by night. Confirm pickup and what food is included before booking.

cho-lon-walk.name: Cho Lon (Chinatown) walk
cho-lon-walk.price_text: Free to walk · market food extra
cho-lon-walk.tip: Wander the lanes around Binh Tay Market for temples, herbs and Chinese-Vietnamese food. Go with a local or a guide first time.

rooftop-view.name: Rooftop bar skyline view
rooftop-view.hours: Most open from late afternoon to late night
rooftop-view.tip: Several District 1 rooftops look over the river and Bitexco. Dress smart-casual and check the dress code.

mekong-day-trip.name: Mekong Delta day trip (My Tho)
mekong-day-trip.hours: Full day, usually early pickup around 07:30–08:30
mekong-day-trip.tip: Boat rides, fruit orchards and villages. It is a long day on the road, so book a small-group tour.

district-7-walk.name: Phu My Hung riverside walk
district-7-walk.hours: Open any time · best in the evening
district-7-walk.tip: A calm, modern riverside area with cafes and parks. A good break from the busy centre.
